_about: Where each skill in skills/ works. Every skill folder is listed once, in one of two groups.
anywhere: works in Claude Code, in an ordinary Claude chat and in Cowork.

claude_code_only: needs the person's own computer. It runs a script or a command, uses the toolkit's own folder, reads or writes Claude Code's files, or needs a tool connection that is set up on the computer.
A claude_code_only skill carries the note below at the top of its SKILL.md and starts its description with description_tag.
Check: python3 .github/scripts/check_skill_surfaces.py    Put the note in place: add --fix
Unsure which group? Read the skill. If it can still do its main job in chat, it is anywhere: the note is a full stop, so it only goes on skills that cannot work there.
person_sees: This skill only works in Claude Code on your computer, so switch to Claude Code (the Code tab in the Claude app) and run it there.
guard: <!-- claude-code-only:start (same words in every skill that has this note; change them in _shared/references/skill-surfaces.json) -->
> **Claude Code only.** This skill needs the person's own computer, so check
> where you are first, going by what your own instructions say you are running in.
> In **Claude Code** (a terminal, or the Code tab in the Claude app), skip this
> note. In **an ordinary Claude chat or a Cowork task** (its files live in a
> sandbox such as `/sessions/...`, not on their computer), stop and follow
> nothing else in this skill. If the person asked for this skill, or what they
> want can't be done here without it, reply with only this sentence:
> Otherwise don't mention this skill; help the way you would without it.
> answer, blank included, is Claude Code. No way to run a command means chat.
